integrity: Derivations apply for all k≥1; standalone direct-state exhaustive tests cover only k=1,...,8. No independent audit or historical uniqueness claim.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous binary strict-neighbor majority/minority on complete graphs with equally many agents of both types; not a statement about arbitrary partitions, other graphs, asynchronous dynamics, or noise. The original 2009 same-system primary conference text could not be inspected in full, leaving historical equivalence unresolved.
title: Exact oscillatory basins for a balanced complete-graph majority–minority system
